blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan – Short films tackling environmental and social issues topped the 6th Hundred Islands Film Festival (HIFF) awards on Saturday (September 12) night, the culmination of the HIFF Film Lab project of the Alaminos City Government. The HIFF Film Lab, started six years ago, is an intensive filmmaking program that aims to nurture young storytellers, strengthen local filmmaking, and provide opportunities for Alaminian filmmakers to create meaningful films inspired by their own community.
